Jack's favorite subject is science. The library desk is big and clean. Lily likes chicken too. Best of all, mom is in the kitchen.
After school, we play together. The hospital guide is my favorite place. I am happy every day. Best of all, the castle is eight hundred years old.
Lily often helps me with science. I like my life very much. Jack goes to the museum on Monday.
